what: Gumroad help center states that PayPal payouts are always processed in USD, usually in 1-3 business days, and that alternative payout modes like Payoneer, Wise, check, money order, and wire transfer are not supported.
verbatim_snippet: "If bank payouts are not supported in your country, you will be paid out via PayPal. You just need to have an individual or business PayPal account without any restrictions. PayPal payouts are always processed in USD, and usually in 1-3 business days. Unfortunately, we do not support alternative payout modes like Payoneer, Wise, check, money order, wire transfer, etc."
